name: Aiman Hakim
bio:
Aiman's fascination with motorsport began early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. This passion led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he gained experience at a local engineering firm, refining his technical skills before landing a role at a smaller racing team. There, he honed his expertise in wind tunnel operations, contributing to significant performance improvements. He is known for his meticulous approach and ability to identify subtle aerodynamic gains. 

Aiman's move to Arrow McLaren was driven by his ambition to work at the highest level of motorsport. He takes pride in his role, understanding its critical importance in optimizing car performance. He is a dedicated team player, always willing to share his knowledge and contribute to a collaborative environment. Aiman is committed to constantly learning and developing his skills, ensuring he stays at the forefront of aerodynamic technology.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating the wind tunnel equipment himself before each session.
